verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a non-interactive, promptless install path that a coding agent can run headlessly from start to finish. The closest items are adjacent: /gstack-upgrade and the GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE flag cover upgrading an existing install, domain-skills covers the agent writing its own per-site notes, and dev mode symlinks a checkout for contributors. None of these is an agent-runnable install of a skill. A community comment mentions a git-clone-and-copy install model, but that is a user-side manual arrangement, not a documented headless installer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can install a skill by itself — a non-interactive, promptless install path an agent can run headlessly end to end
